caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional, square-shaped building with a detailed and ornate appearance, labeled “HOME BANK” above its arched front doorway. The structure is rendered in muted earth tones, primarily brown and beige, with green accents along its roof edges and around its corners. The facade features arched windows and door, with diamond-patterned grilles on the side windows. There is a small set of steps leading up to the door. The roof has a steep pitch with dormer windows on each side and an elaborate, scalloped cresting along its central peak. Mounted on the roof is a device resembling a weather vane or bell. In the top left corner of the drawing, there is an inset showing a close-up of a figure labeled "CASHIER," standing behind a counter or inside a window niche, dressed in period clothing and holding items in both hands. The overall composition centers the bank building while presenting the cashier detail as a separate inset, and the artist's signature, "Frank H. Gray," is visible at the lower right corner.
title: Home Bank
